profile.headline: Media Platform Video Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software developer/programmer.  My skills are firmly based in my ability to solve problems using the tools that I'm provided.  I've got a lot of history and skills associated with C, C++, Objective C and various scripting languages.  At the same time I've been able to successfully produce solutions in a variety of languages and platforms.
I want to continue to work on interesting and compelling problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Well. We're back... in the car, err Yahoo again.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Maintain the Sanford Guide on iOS platforms.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: While at Agilex, I've written dozens of apps ranging from proof of concept to demo's to fully implemented app in the App Store.  The most interesting app was an offline Mapping solution for a government customer.  Working with another Senior iOS Developer we built from the ground up a fast OpenGL based mapping solution using the customers own mapping data.  It was a very challenging and rewarding experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was part of a team that designed, built and deployed a very low power satellite communications device.  The device was built around an 8 bit Atmel processor with an OLED screen.  I got to write and debug all of the software for the first version of this device, that included all OLED screen rendering and all the sensor and low power management of the device.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on a global communication system written on Solaris with C, C++ and lots of scripting.  My software ran and monitored the rest of the system.  We deployed the system worldwide while I was on the project and delivered a couple of updates.  From what I've heard this system is still deployed and running.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: A brief stint working with a company that has working with Napster.  Relatable was working on algorithms to identify music tracks based on a small snippet.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I implemented a Java based solution for automating a Senior Management Tool used during consulting sessions with a Multinational Companies Senior staff.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: I worked on a team assembling a components for Software Architecture roadmap that would simplify customers enhancing their initial Software Architecture implementations.

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description: I worked on this startup spun off by Btg working on a web based community network for cable companies.  We were trying to incorporate very early incarnations of Java (1.1 SDK) into a system that would simplify the creation of personal web spaces for cable customers.  The system was deployed only to a one system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked prototyping cutting edge data mining solutions for classified government customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on a C++ solution for a classified government customer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My time at BTG was spent developing enterprise systems on Unix using primarily C and  a little C++ for classified government customers.

projects.title: Morse Elmer
projects.description: I've had a long running interest to learn Morse Code.  I couldn't find any decent mobile solutions at the time so I decided to write an iOS app.  It was an opportunity to thoroughly understand the underlying audio basis of CW communication and learn how to accurately implement a solution to train with on an iOS platform.  The app has been downloaded thousands of times and more than 1000+ users have updated to the most recent 1.3 release.
